items.value: The Limelight is a vision camera, it's pretty useful and I think is used by the best FRC teams in the world. Most people use it for position and angle tracking via Apriltags.

Let's first go set up Constants for it. Looking at past seasons (Where I unfortunately had either guessed what documentation is good for the 2026 season or have 0 documentation to work with for the 2024 Season) I'll explain some Constants used in the 2024 Season first.

Firstly, we've got kMountAngleRadians, which is essentially camera tilt, as typically, the robot has a very specific angle to look at Apriltags for ... Ok I should probably see about getting either of the mentors at the time who worked on Limelight more than me to explain these Constants.
